situation: A pagination component shows pages 1 through N but the last page is never reachable. The loop that generates page buttons iterates while pageIndex < totalPages, but since pages are 1-indexed the final page is skipped when pageIndex equals totalPages.
deadEnds: Checked the data-fetching layer assuming the last page of results was empty
Tried adjusting totalPages calculation with Math.ceil, but the count was already correct
Added +1 to totalPages as a workaround, which created an empty extra page
unlock: The boundary condition in the loop was exclusive when it needed to be inclusive. Changing < to <= (or switching to 0-indexed iteration with < totalPages) fixed the off-by-one so every page is reachable.
